# Lender Ready Models

> Excel templates for commercial real estate loan underwriting: debt sizing under LTV, DSCR and debt yield; construction and bridge loans; equity waterfalls; rent roll analysis; self-storage lease-up; and real estate debt fund returns. Plain .xlsx files with live formulas, no macros. Built by an AI system under a finance professional's specification and recalculated with an independent engine before release. Modelling tools, not financial, investment, lending or legal advice.

## Templates (price in USD, sold on Gumroad)
- [DSCR Debt Sizing & Loan Underwriting Model](https://lender-ready-models.onrender.com/#dscr): $79. Sizes the maximum loan under LTV, DSCR and debt yield, shows which test binds, and stresses rate and NOI.
- [Equity Waterfall Model (IRR Hurdles & Promote)](https://lender-ready-models.onrender.com/#waterfall): $89. LP/GP distribution waterfall with up to four IRR hurdle tiers.
- [Multifamily Rent Roll Analyzer](https://lender-ready-models.onrender.com/#rentroll): $69. Loss-to-lease, physical and economic occupancy, lease expirations, in-place versus mark-to-market NOI.
- [Construction Loan Model](https://lender-ready-models.onrender.com/#construction): $129. Sources and uses, S-curve draw schedule with retainage, interest reserve, permanent-loan takeout test.
- [Private Credit / Real Estate Debt Fund Model](https://lender-ready-models.onrender.com/#debtfund): $169. Ten-year closed-end debt fund with credit losses, subscription line, fees and a European waterfall.
- [Bridge-to-Agency Refinance Model](https://lender-ready-models.onrender.com/#bridge): $139. Value-add multifamily bridge loan through an agency takeout.
- [Self-Storage Acquisition & Lease-Up Underwriting Model](https://lender-ready-models.onrender.com/#storage): $119. Unit mix, absorption, loan sizing and LP/GP returns.

## Free calculators
- [Debt yield calculator](https://lender-ready-models.onrender.com/debt-yield-calculator): debt yield on a loan, and the maximum loan under debt yield, DSCR and LTV.
- [Loss-to-lease calculator](https://lender-ready-models.onrender.com/#calc): loss-to-lease and mark-to-market value from a unit-type rent roll.
